core_obligations: Setup: let N be the integer from the boundedness lemma; the adjunction defining Rf^! gives Hom_X(L, Rf^!K) = Hom_Y(Rf_!L, K) for all L, K (proof lines 4114-4117).

Truncation test: assume H^i(K) = 0 for i < a and take L = tau_{\leq a-N-1} Rf^!K; by the boundedness lemma Rf_!L has vanishing cohomology sheaves in degrees <= a - 1, so Hom_Y(Rf_!L, K) = 0 by the negative exts lemma (proof lines 4117-4122).
Conclusion: the canonical map tau_{\leq a-N-1} Rf^!K -> Rf^!K is zero, whence H^i(Rf^!K) = 0 for i <= a - N - 1 (proof lines 4123-4124).
proof_roadmap: Adjunction and choice of N (proof lines 4114-4117).
Truncation map zero gives the bound (proof lines 4123-4124).
